title: cymbopogon ambiguus
intro: Cymbopogon ambiguus, commonly known as Lemon Grass, is a species of tropical grass native to Australia and Southeast Asia. This plant is known for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to aid digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of anxiety and depression. The therapeutic actions of Cymbopogon ambiguus include its antiseptic, anti-inflammatory, and antifungal properties, which contribute to its use in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of this plant include citral, geraniol, and limonene, which are responsible for its distinctive citrus aroma and therapeutic effects.
